title: Money leaving a card: a closed card's credit sent back to the bank, a cash advance into the bank, cash taken at an ATM (final_review_1 finding 5, decision O5)
story: Two banks opened Mon 4 Jan 2027 with 100,000 each, and a cash wallet with nothing in it. Card 1 is paid from bank 1, card 2 from bank 2; both close on the 15th and are paid in full on the 10th of the next month (moved later), and both opened with their 15 Dec statement at 0, paid. Card 1: a refund of 3,000 on Wed 20 Jan after the person stopped using it; on Sat 20 Feb the card company sends that credit to bank 1. Card 2 (cash rate 18% a year, stored for stage 2): a cash advance of 20,000 into bank 2 on Wed 20 Jan, and 5,000 cash taken at an ATM on Fri 22 Jan. No pay is set up. Every amount is made up.
